# tebib_subnet (Resource)

A dual-stack subnet in a VPC. VMs attach to a subnet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_subnet" "web" {
  name   = "web"
  vpc_id = tebib_vpc.main.id
  cidr   = "10.1.1.0/24"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) IPv4 range inside the VPC's, e.g. `10.1.1.0/24`. Changing it replaces the subnet.
- `name` (String) Name, unique among the project's subnets. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC ID. Changing it replaces the subnet.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 255 characters. Default: empty.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`p-...`). Default: the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags (key-value pairs). IAM policies can match them. Default: none.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `available_ipv4` (Number) Free IPv4 addresses.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `gateway` (String) IPv4 gateway address.
- `id` (String) Subnet ID (`subnet-...`).
- `ipv6_cidr` (String) The subnet's IPv6 range.
- `ipv6_gateway` (String) IPv6 gateway address.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the project's default subnet.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state: `active` once ready (or `error`).
- `status_message` (String) What the platform last said about the resource.
- `trn` (String) TebibHost resource name (TRN), for IAM policies.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tebib_subnet.web subnet-abc123
```
